synthesis: Key forensic distinction: In greedy mode, the pilot checkpoint collapses into the passcop and XML attractors (16 unique strings / 30). Under T=0.7 and top-p=0.9, unique string count reaches 30/30 (1.0 lexical diversity). However, semantic evaluation confirms that 100% of these sampled responses remain entirely unconditioned on the instruction (generating disordered English or multilingual word salads). High sampling entropy masks representation collapse lexically, but does NOT resolve the semantic bottleneck.
